name: Google Ads MCC
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
TAG manages client Google Ads under one manager account (MCC **805-257-4115**). Claude reads it through the official `google-ads-mcp` server (installed with pipx; config lives in `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\.mcp.json` and an ADC credential file in `google-ads\` [redacted, never opened]). The connection is read-only by design.

| Sub-account | Customer ID |
|---|---|
| Pipeliners | 7219095860 (721-909-5860) |
| Summit Plumbing Pros | 1401013750 (140-101-3750) |
| Alphalete Trenchless | 1400614219 (140-061-4219) |

# Standing rules
- **Read-only for Claude.** Never push changes to any TAG Ads account. Output recommendations as copy-paste lists that Kim applies in the UI.
- Kim can explicitly authorize a specific live browser change; campaign-level negatives were reliable, the positive-keyword panel and shared-list page were flaky.
- Build keywords and negatives from the search term **verbatim**; never reword or reorder.
- State scope (keyword vs ad group vs campaign, with full names) up front on every recommendation.
- Watch the GAQL gotcha: filtering by `campaign.name` also matches REMOVED campaigns with the same name; filter by status or ID before calling anything a duplicate.
- The MCP cannot return Keyword Planner volumes.

# Recurring workflow: search-terms review
1. Read `Search-Terms-Check-Log.md` for each campaign's last check date ([Search Terms Check Log](lib:brain-search-terms-check-log)).
2. Pull only that window; classify each term as negative, target or skip, verbatim.
3. Conflict-check at campaign and ad-group level; Kim approves and applies; verify via API; update the log.

# Folder contents (`google-ads\`)
- Alphalete negatives work from May 26 to 27, 2026: search terms May 15 to 26 (about 380 rows), classified terms, recommended negatives, an "add now" list, campaign-level and shared-list CSVs and copy-paste blocks for campaign "AT | CIPP Residential | Search | CO Springs".
- PowerShell helpers: `classify_search_terms.ps1`, `recommend_negatives.ps1`, `format_negatives_copypaste.ps1`; Node helpers to generate the SOP and session-notes .docx and a refresh-token script (scripts not summarized).
- `validation\`: the May 27 to 29 validation and conversion-tracking audit (see [Google Ads Validation Work](lib:brain-google-ads-validation-work)).

# Known account issues (from audits and handoffs)
- Pipeliners: conversion goals are misconfigured (leads fire but are mis-counted, so Search bids drift toward zero); fix goals before pausing anything. "GHL Calls from Landing Page" only counts calls of 60 seconds or more by design; keep the gate and fix GCLID pass-through.
- GHL iframe forms silently stopped on-site conversions on all three accounts in spring 2026.
- Alphalete recorded zero Ads conversions Sep 4 to 13, 2026 (140 clicks, $1,291.77), tied to WhatConverts upload gaps and rejections ([WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts)).

# Status and pending (as of the Oct 1 handoff)
- Scott is hiring a dedicated Ads person; Kim's weekly Google Ads Keystone tasks were deleted.
- Waiting on Scott or the new hire: Pipeliners attribution fix, Summit conversion-tracking fix, confirm Alphalete's "New form of payment required" notice is resolved, close the stale "Shift Google Ads budget to LSA" Keystone item, recreate a weekly Ads recurrence for the new owner.
